name: Yatoon Restaurant Menu & Online Ordering with AI Assistant
author: yatoon

sections.description:
Create a branded restaurant photo menu and accept commission-free pickup orders paid directly to the restaurant. WooCommerce is not required.

Organize dishes with categories, photos, options, modifiers, allergen notes, stock limits and special instructions. Set prices and currency, restaurant hours and closures, scheduled pickup, customer accounts, email notifications, reservations and a staff kitchen display. The checkout phone country code follows the restaurant country selected in settings.

The optional AI Food Assistant can suggest dishes from your menu when a WordPress AI provider is connected. Normal menu browsing and ordering work without AI. Customers can switch the ordering interface between English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish, French and German when the restaurant enables the language selector in Checkout & language settings. Restaurant-written dish names and descriptions remain unchanged. Optional menu structured data and consent-based analytics help customers discover the menu while leaving analytics under the site’s consent setup.

Free includes pickup ordering and pay-at-pickup. It does not include online payment gateways, SMS, delivery or dine-in ordering, table QR ordering, multi-location ordering, sales reports, loyalty campaigns or cloud printing; these are available in Yatoon Pro.

Shortcodes

  • [yatoon_menu] – menu and checkout
  • [yatoon_kitchen] – logged-in kitchen/operations staff only
  • [yatoon_order_status] – customer tracking with the order’s private tracking key/contact
  • [yatoon_reservations] – reservation requests

External Services

Freemius provides optional account connection, licensing and updates. Its SDK controls the opt-in connection flow.
Terms: https://freemius.com/terms/ Privacy: https://freemius.com/privacy/

Optional Google sign-in loads Google Identity Services only when a client ID is configured. The identity token is sent to Google for verification.
Terms: https://policies.google.com/terms Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Optional Facebook login sends the login token to Meta to verify the app and retrieve the chosen profile/email.
Terms: https://www.facebook.com/terms.php Privacy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/

Optional Apple sign-in loads Apple’s web SDK and verifies the signed identity token against Apple’s public keys.
Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/terms/site.html Privacy: https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy/

The optional AI food assistant sends the customer’s request and available menu descriptions to the provider connected to the WordPress AI Client.
No AI provider keys are collected by this plugin. Provider selection is controlled by the WordPress connector and assistant settings.
Google terms/privacy: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms and https://policies.google.com/privacy
OpenAI terms/privacy: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/ and https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/
Anthropic terms/privacy: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/commercial-terms and https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy

Optional order spam check: when a site owner enables Cloudflare Turnstile or hCaptcha in the plugin settings, the customer’s browser loads that provider’s script on the checkout, and the one-time check token plus the visitor’s IP address are sent to the provider by the server to verify it. Nothing is sent unless a provider and its keys are configured.
Cloudflare terms/privacy: https://www.cloudflare.com/website-terms/ and https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/
hCaptcha terms/privacy: https://www.hcaptcha.com/terms and https://www.hcaptcha.com/privacy

Order/contact information is stored in the site’s WordPress database and sent to the restaurant and customer through the site’s configured email service.
New email/password accounts must follow the emailed password setup link before signing in. The WordPress password reset flow also verifies these accounts.

Menu information and integrations

Confirm allergens while editing each dish. An empty allergen list means no information was supplied; it does not mean a dish is allergen-free. Customers should contact the restaurant about allergies and shared preparation areas.

Menu JSON-LD describes the public restaurant menu and prices. It does not guarantee a specific search result format. Sites using another menu schema provider may disable this output with the yatoon_menu_enable_schema filter.

Analytics & integrations offers an optional ecommerce event bridge for your existing Google Tag Manager/GA4 and Meta Pixel setup. It is off by default. No analytics scripts are installed. Forwarding requires explicit visitor consent through your consent manager and the documented YatoonAnalytics.setConsent interface. Customer contact details, addresses and notes are excluded. Configure the associated services and privacy disclosures before enabling this feature.

The Appearance screen offers everyday and seasonal menu themes, including Christmas. You can switch themes at any time; theme selection does not change prices or ordering settings.
sections.installation:
1. Upload and activate this Free plugin. Deactivate any other Yatoon edition first.
  2. Open Yatoon Restaurant Menu > Setup Wizard and create pages.
  3. Add menu items and configure pickup, currency, email, hours and closed dates.
  4. Place a test pickup order and verify the staff kitchen screen and emails.
  5. If upgrading to Pro, install the separate Pro ZIP and activate the license there.
sections.changelog:
3.4.0

  • Improved mobile menu and checkout layout, restaurant branding, service hours and resilient total calculation. Price details open by default so customers can see subtotal, tax and fees. Checkout now defaults the phone dialing code from the restaurant’s configured country.
  • Improved reservation hours, booking limits, reopening checks and retryable email notifications; clarified order status and kitchen ticket handling.
  • Added allergen information, menu structured data, optional consent-based analytics, seasonal menu themes, accessibility and translation improvements.
  • Improved setup guidance, category and menu management, currency handling and scheduling safeguards.
  • Passed the WordPress.org Plugin Check with no errors.

3.3.2

  • Added category management and first-run setup tools; improved currency selection, responsive admin screens and checkout reliability.

3.3.1

  • Improved payment and notification reliability, account security, checkout protection and mobile administration.
